wiki.summary: The Band is track 3 off of God Save The Three. This song starts off with a dialogue snippet of glaive talking about quitting what seems like addictions, which could be talking about glaives smoking habit. This combined with the lyrics talking about smoking fags and stealing a fag off a Chinese man could back up this claim. glaive’s chorus also interpolates The Killers 2003 song “Mr. Brightside”. Kurtains’ verse talks about trying to quit [drinking?] but he quit at quitting. Read more on Last.fm.
